findings.text: §42 declares "Crew-surface §7's repair-and-check node holds four of these files, so §42 is dispatched only after it lands", but the plan's `plan-section-depends-on` meta (plan.html:22) has no `s42` entry, so the edge the section relies on is recorded nowhere a dispatcher reads

findings.reason: a coordinator that waits only §7's node and then dispatches §42 collides with §9's filter node over `reckon/mcp_views.py`, the file §42 must edit to register its view.
findings.text: the named node is the wrong one: crew-surface §7's repair-and-check node (`cso-repair-and-check-families-fold`) holds two of §42's files (`reckon/crew_run_commands.py`, `skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md`), while the four whose fences do overlap are crew-surface §9's nodes — `reckon/mcp_views.py`, `reckon/crew_run_commands.py`, `skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md` and `tests/test_skill_contracts.py`, with §9's filter node additionally taking `reckon/_mcp_tools.py`, as the crew-surface plan's own deferral note for §9 records

findings.reason: the plan states no rule mapping the catalogue id to the name the lane's command accepts, so the probe either names a model the CLI refuses or every node invents its own mapping, and §43's gate cannot see it because it stubs the probe command.
findings.text: §43's probe "goes through that lane's own command, with the notice's model", but a `released` notice exists precisely for an id no lane declares, so the only id it carries is the catalogue id from the watched list (`anthropic/claude-…`), while the host flight's claude lane commands take the bare local names `claude-haiku-5-5` and `claude-fable-5-1`, and §42 adds `catalog_id` precisely because the two forms differ

findings.reason: a node that leaves `--until` required writes an acknowledgement that expires, so a notice returns after its instant while the plan and its own test both assert it does not.
findings.text: §42 acknowledges a notice through `crew ack`, whose shipped form carries `--reason` and `--until` as required, time-bounded options (reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1452), while line 463 and the done-when hold that "an acknowledged notice is not raised again on the next check"; the section fixes only which of run-id and notice-id is required and never says whether a notice acknowledgement takes `--until`
